structures.questionTemplate:
Express the following fraction in simplest form:

$$
\frac{${scope.num}}{${scope.den}}
$$
steps: Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of ${scope.num} and ${scope.den}, which is ${scope.g}.

Divide both the numerator and the denominator by ${scope.g}:

$$\frac{${scope.num} \div ${scope.g}}{${scope.den} \div ${scope.g}} = \frac{${scope.n}}{${scope.d}}$$
The fraction in simplest form is ${scope.ans}.

Find a common denominator and combine numerators:

$$\frac{${scope.num1}}{${scope.common_d}} ${scope.op} \frac{${scope.num2}}{${scope.common_d}} = \frac{${scope.res_num}}{${scope.common_d}}$$
Simplify the resulting fraction to get: ${scope.ans}.

Multiply numerators and denominators (or multiply by the reciprocal for division):

$$\frac{${scope.res_n}}{${scope.res_d}}$$
Simplify the fraction to simplest form: ${scope.ans}.
